title: Agent-Native Telemetry: Verifiable State-Delta Evidence for Autonomous Operations
abstract: arXiv:2608.16178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Operational telemetry is predominantly engineered for human reading: systems repeatedly serialize verbose prose, static keys, and redundant context across billions of log lines. As autonomous AI agents become primary operational consumers, feeding them traditional logs wastes scarce context capacity parsing lexical syntax rather than reasoning over system state changes -- all while lacking cryptographic guarantees of provenance or collection completeness.   This paper introduces agent-native telemetry, an operational evidence architecture for autonomous machine operators founded on verifiable state deltas rather than human prose. We present the Agent Telemetry Protocol (ATP) and the State-Delta Evidence Ledger, an implementation that structures operational facts into four core evidence primitives (Transitions, Observations, Relations, and State Checkpoints) governed by content-addressed schemas, while isolating uncurated text as digest

translated_title: 智能体原生遥测：用于自主操作的可验证状态增量证据
translated_abstract: 运营遥测技术主要面向人类阅读设计：系统在数十亿行日志中反复序列化冗长的文本、静态键和冗余上下文。随着自主AI智能体成为主要运营消费者，向它们提供传统日志会浪费稀缺的上下文容量，用于解析词汇语法而非推理系统状态变化——同时缺乏来源或收集完整性的加密保证。本文介绍了智能体原生遥测，一种面向自主机器操作者的运营证据架构，基于可验证的状态增量而非人类文本。我们提出了智能体遥测协议（ATP）和状态增量证据账本，该实现将运营事实结构化为四种核心证据原语（转换、观察、关系和状态检查点），由内容寻址模式管理，同时将非策展文本隔离为摘要。
tldr: 本文提出智能体原生遥测架构，通过ATP协议和状态增量证据账本，将运营数据转化为可验证的状态增量证据，解决自主AI智能体消费传统日志的低效和信任问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces agent-native telemetry architecture that transforms operational data into verifiable state-delta evidence via the ATP protocol and State-Delta Evidence Ledger, addressing inefficiency and trust issues when autonomous AI agents consume traditional logs.
